title: AU Vetta quarterly airport lounge access

conditions.value: one visit per quarter, domestic and international counted separately

exclusions: The page states one complimentary domestic and one international visit per quarter. The quantity records a single visit per quarter because the shape cannot express two different scopes in one entry; the allowance above keeps both figures.
The page does not name the lounge programme or the participating lounges, so neither is asserted.
No automated redemption authorization is implied.
redemption_steps: Present the card at a participating lounge.
Check the current participating list before travelling, since the page does not name it.
